created_by.description: Only alerts created by the user with this UUID.

legacy_configuration_id.description: Only the alert copied from, or created with, this source configuration, such as a logs alert's id.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

source_kind.description:
Only alerts of this source kind, such as metrics. A kind the caller cannot read returns no alerts.

* `logs` - Logs
* `insight` - Insight
* `warehouse_source` - Warehouse source
* `warehouse_destination` - Warehouse destination
* `metrics` - Metrics
* `traces` - Traces
* `error_tracking` - Error tracking
